sentences.text:
(Per Hon'ble Sri Justice P.Naveen Rao) This writ petition is filed praying to grant the following relief:
"...to issue an appropriate Writ, Order or Direction more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Habeas Corpus directing 3rd Respondent to produce the detenue i.e. Mohammed Shanawaz Ghazi @ lmran now detained in Central Prison,
Hyderabad at Chanchalguda before this Hon'ble Court and set-aside the impunged detention order passed by the 2nd Respondent vide SB (I) No.238/PD-3/HYD/2021 dated 24-09-2021 and approved by the 1st Respondent as being illegal, arbitrary,
improper, unilateral, unconstitutional and violative of Article 21 and 22 of the Constitution of India and to forthwith release the Detenue and to grant such other relief or reliefs as this Honble Court deems fit and proper in the circumstances of the case..."

2. Heard Sri R. Sowmya Reddy, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Government Pleader for Home, appearing for the respondents.
3.

This writ petition is filed by uncle of the detenue, challenging the order of detention of Mohammed Shanawaz Ghazi @ Imran, by order dated 24.09.2021, in exercise of power under Section 3(2) of the Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Bootleggers, Dacoits,
Drug-Offenders, Goondas, Immoral Traffic Offenders, Land Grabbers, Spurious Seed Offenders,
Insecticide Offenders, Fertiliser Offenders, Food Adulteration Offenders, Fake Document Offenders,
Scheduled Commodities Offenders, Forest Offenders, Gaming Offenders, Sexual Offenders,
Explosive Substances Offenders, Arms Offenders, Cyber Crime Offenders and While Collar or Financial Offenders Act, 1986 (Act No.1 of 1986).
4.

entities.text: Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities of Bootleggers, Dacoits
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The order of detention refers to two crimes reported against dentenue.

In support of the decision to detain the dentenue, Crime No.430 of 2020 was registered under Section 324, 506 r/w 34 of IPC,
in Falaknuma Police Station.
In the said crime, a notice under Section 41 (A) of Criminal Procedure Code was issued to detenue on 04.12.2020 and let him of with certain directions.
Crime No.68 of 2021 was registered under Section 120-B, 302 r/w 34 of IPC and Section 27(3) of Arms Act, 1959, in Falaknuma Police Station.
5. Leaving aside Crime No.430 of 2020 which was a petty offence, the crime that is staring at detenue is Crime No.68 of 2021.

As can be seen from the remand report filed in Crime No.68 of 2021, it was alleged that detenue bore grudge against Mohd Jaber - the victim, on the allegation that Mohd Jaber committed murder of the brother of detenue in front of him.
Further, he hatched a plan with five other co-accused to commit the crime.
It appears that co-accused also had reasons to commit crime against the victim.
Thus, it is apparent that the killing of victim leading to registration of Crime No.68 of 2021 was on account of personal rivalry of the detenue.
By involving in such crime, it cannot be said that detenue would be resorting to committing similar crimes, having an impact on public order.
Further, except these two crimes, there is no history of detenue involving in crimes of similar nature.
Therefore, we see no reason for resorting to the extreme measure of preventive detention of detenue.

sentences.text: In the result, the Writ Petition is allowed.

The impugned detention order passed by the Office of the Commissioner of Police, Hyderabad City- 2nd respondent vide SB (I) No.238/PD-3/HYD/2021 dated 24.09.2021 and the consequential confirmation order of the Principal Secretary, General Administration (SPL. (Law & Order) Department, Secretariat, Hyderabad- 1st respondent approving the detention vide G.O.Rt.No.2592, General Administration (SPL. (Law & Order) Department dated 25.11.2021, are hereby set aside.

The respondents are directed to set the detenu, namely Mohammed Shanawaz Ghazi @ Imran, S/o. Mohammed Siraj-ul-Islam Ghazi, aged about 28 years, Occupation :
Business, R/o. H.No.19-2-21/23/54/A/87, Near Meraj Masjid, Basharat Nagar, Nawab Saheb Kunta, Hyderabad, at liberty forthwith, if he is no longer required in any other criminal case.
Miscellaneous petitions, pending if any, shall stand closed.
